85: - **Base URL**: `http://127.0.0.1:8088` (or dynamic port detected at startup)

90: - **`GET /api/stream`**:
91:   - Query parameters:
92:     - `tmdbId`: string (e.g. `"27205"`)
93:     - `type`: `"movie"` | `"tv"`
94:     - `season`: string (optional, for tv)
95:     - `episode`: string (optional, for tv)
96:     - `server`: string (optional, defaults to `"secret"`)
97:   - Response (JSON):
98:     ```json
99:     {
100:       "success": true,
101:       "streamUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8088/hls/proxy?url=https%3A%2F%2Flightspeed.st%2Fhls%2F...%2Fmaster.m3u8",
102:       "originalUrl": "https://lightspeed.st/hls/.../master.m3u8",
103:       "server": "secret",
104:       "subtitles": [

106:       ]
107:     }
108:     ```

110:   - Forwards request to target with headers `Origin: https://cinejoy.pk` and `Referer: https://cinejoy.pk/`.
